meta.title: WorkBuddy Version Guard
meta.description: Companion guard for dsh-connect-workbuddy: compares the WorkBuddy version taken from the official update endpoint and the installer filename (whichever is higher) against a stored baseline, and on mismatch prompts, disables dsh-connect-workbuddy, softly stops the sessions still using it, and leaves a persistent watermark at the top of the UI.
